measures.what: body length and width below the mounting tabs, and height from the underside of the mounting tabs to the bottom of the servo body
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom)

measures.what: total length across the mounting tabs, tab thickness, hole diameter, hole-to-hole center spacing along the servo length, and hole-to-hole center spacing across the servo width
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo tab thickness: 2.28 mm

measures.what: height and width of the wire grommet/exit below the mounting tab, and which side it's on
measures.reply: servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom)
